quests.title: The Dog at Quakers Hill
quests.blurb: A dog meets the 5:40 at Quakers Hill every weekday and nobody gets off for it. Four months of this. I have decided it is not going to be a sad story. Find out whose it is.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at Toongabbie
quests.blurb: I run a small book on things that are not races — weather, delays, whether the just gone midnight out of Toongabbie runs on time. Somebody is beating it by information, not luck. Ride the run they ride.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$25 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of Ourimbah
quests.blurb: The last one through Ourimbah carries four people and one of them is always asleep. Ride it to Lisarow, photograph the platform with nobody on it, and come back and tell me the place still exists when there is no one in it.

steps.label: ride the late one to Lisarow
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.title: The Kensington Tap-Off
quests.blurb: A card ending 56 boards at Kensington on Thursdays and vanishes. Not a fare thing — ninety cents. I want to know *how*, and nobody will put it in writing.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph it before somebody welds it

quests.title: The Chester Hill Order
quests.blurb: Two hundred coffees out of Chester Hill before quarter to six and I know every one of them by the walk. A kid who should be at school stopped coming three weeks back. Take one over to where they work and find out whether I lost them to the chain up the road.

steps.label: order one at the Chester Hill kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $29 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Leumeah
quests.blurb: Nobody upstairs believes me about Leumeah because I have 6 years and no data. Go and stand on that platform on school holidays and get me the data, and it has been like that since the merge.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Unclaimed at Roseville
quests.blurb: Somebody lost something off the Roseville line on the long weekend and has not come for it, which never happens. Find out why not.

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
$26 — whatever it is, it is worth that to somebody

quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Seven Hills
quests.blurb: The quiet carriage runs on shame and somebody on the five in the morning out of Seven Hills has stopped feeling it. Ride it, see the crime, and apply the shame manually.

steps.label: ride the quiet carriage and observe the crime
apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Woonona Shortcut
quests.blurb: Every courier has a route that is not on a map and mine goes through Woonona. They have started locking one end. Go and find out whether it is locked forever or just locked today.

steps.label: the end they lock
the long way round, so you understand what it costs
$24, which is what the long way costs me a week

quests.title: Possession at Penshurst
quests.blurb: Third time at Penshurst on a Tuesday. Not kids — kids run. This one walks, and I have run out of ways to say it politely. I need it stopped before somebody writes a very long report about me.

steps.label: where they come through the fence
the ones who think a hard hat is a costume
photograph the gap so I can put a number on the form

quests.title: The Arncliffe Regular
quests.blurb: Same stool since before I bought the place off Arncliffe road. Gone since the week of the show, and they keep sending a different bloke. I would like to know whether to keep the stool.

steps.label: the house they say he moved to
you cannot ask a favour empty-handed
come back and tell me straight

quests.title: Bay 14, Turramurra
quests.blurb: People have started parking on the grass at Turramurra because of one abandoned car, and nobody will put it in writing. Photograph it, and the date on the ticket, so somebody can be embarrassed by it.

steps.label: the car, and the ticket, and the date on it
the two arguing over the grass
$30 in fines nobody is going to collect

quests.title: Whatever Is Under the Grey at Caringbah
quests.blurb: Council pays me to paint over things and last week I painted over something good. There is another one near Caringbah that I am scheduled to kill on grand final week. Photograph it first.

steps.label: the wall, before they get to it
photograph it properly, not a phone-in-a-hurry job
show me

quests.title: The Hill Above Menangle
quests.blurb: There is a bench on the hill above Menangle I have watched from a moving bus about fourteen thousand times. I am not going to stop — that is not the kind of person I turned out to be. So you go, at two in the afternoon, when the light is worth it.

steps.label: up the hill, the way the road does not go
the view I have never stopped for
$30, because I am paying you for it

quests.title: Contesting It at St Marys
quests.blurb: Done at St Marys on Thursdays for something that is only an offence if a sign says so, and it has been like that since the merge. How do you photograph a thing not being somewhere? That is your problem now.

steps.label: where the sign is supposed to be
photograph the absence, which is harder than it sounds
the one who tells you photography is not allowed here

quests.title: The Strip Outside Petersham
quests.blurb: Nobody planted the strip at Petersham. I did, on a wet Monday, at the back of seven, so nobody would ask. I would like the fifteenth to go badly for council.

steps.label: the strip, which is a garden now
the man with the whipper snipper
photograph it while it still exists

quests.title: Night Fill, Holsworthy
quests.blurb: Started on a wet Monday. In off the Holsworthy late train, gone before the first delivery, every time, and I am past being reasonable about it. Come in on the late one and watch the loading door.

steps.label: come in on the late one like they do
the loading door nobody watches
whoever is standing in it at two in the morning
$33 of what they took, back

quests.title: The Window Above Doonside
quests.blurb: 6 years above Doonside. I do not hear the trains any more, which means I hear it instantly when one of them is wrong. Since every second Friday the joins sound different.

steps.label: ride it and listen to the joins
photograph the stretch that sounds wrong
tell me I am not mad

quests.title: Setting Up at Scarborough
quests.blurb: 25 years in the Scarborough market. The bays are not allocated, they are *known*, and since Thursdays somebody has decided that knowing does not count, and I have stopped filling in the form.

steps.label: the bays, at the hour it happens
the bloke with the extra trestle
you will want one at that hour
$25 of frontage, recovered

quests.title: The Clock at Helensburgh
quests.blurb: Somebody set the Helensburgh clock that way on purpose and everyone who knows why is nearly gone. The old crew drink near Otford on Thursdays. Go and ask, and I am the only one who seems to have noticed.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to Otford, where the old crew drink
bring the name back
